$Comment: The skeleton every Christmas quest inherits through Parent. It is never offered.
Season hides every quest built on it while Christmas is off; a child that writes its own Requires
(the quest before it) keeps it, since Season is a leaf of its own, and Christmas Morning writes its
own Season (Christmas_Morning) in its place. Hidden keeps each quest off open lists, so it is offered
only at its giver, and RequirePrerequisites keeps a locked one out of sight. MainLine makes the story
main quests (a list shows them first, with a gold bar and a star); a quest that repeats on a daily or
other periodic reset reads as repeatable whatever this says, while one that repeats only once per run
of Christmas stays a main quest.
Npc binds them all to Santa (the role Christmas_Santa, which his placement stands under with no NpcId
of its own), who takes the hand-ins, and CompletionDialogue sends a finished quest back to his
conversation. A helper's quest names the helper instead, by the id that helper keeps in both seasons
(Harvest_Feast_Miller for Tomas, Harvest_Feast_Weaver for Elsie, Harvest_Feast_Shepherd for Bram),
A child adds its Listing (icon, category, order, its tier in the story), its Requires, its
Objectives, its Rewards and any Repeat, and takes its words from the keys its id spells
(quest.<id>.title and .flavor). This file sits outside the _Christmas folder on purpose: its file name
already spells its id, so Parent names it the same way in the game and in the build's own content
Name: Christmas_Quest_Base
